regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, high-carry leadership concentration in Hong Kong: Banks (H + HK) lead decisively (score 1.315, durability 0.63, breadth 0.769) but has a mean-revert Hurst tag and is NOT scorable (no ETF proxy). One-narrative dominance is false, rotation breadth is narrow (4 of 17 eligible; absorption 0.46), and gate_helps is true — so the validated leg is risk control, not return forecasting. Only two themes are scorable (China Tech & Internet; China Platform Megacaps), and both rank near the bottom, making most of this note unscorable and low-conviction by construction.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the prevailing narrative leader and the only eligible theme with strong durability (0.63) and real breadth (0.769), suggesting the leadership is broad-based rather than a single-name fluke. With gate_helps true, the trend-gate leg supports staying with the eligible leader on a risk-control basis, not a return-forecast basis. The Hurst tag is mean-revert, which argues for humility and a modest rather than assertive lean — the momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert, which historically means the absolute-trend gate does NOT capture a persistent edge for this them; the leading rank is a focus lens with rank-IC ~0, and unscorable means this lean cannot be graded against an ETF proxy.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) theme loses its eligible status or its durability_bar drops below 0.5 before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is scorable (3033.HK) but ranks 13 of 17 with score -0.395, is not eligible, and has weak durability (0.18) with a mean-revert Hurst tag. The trend-gate leg — the only validated edge — says ineligible themes are to be avoided on a risk-control basis. This is a defensive avoid, not a short or a fade (guardrails forbid fading).
evidence: do_not_conclude: momentum rank is not a buy list
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags on an already-low rank could snap back sharply, and the macro narrative is dominated by AI-tech headlines (17 of 36) which may favor China Tech & Internet if attention rotates; avoiding outright could miss a rebound.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK becomes eligible and its durability_bar rises above 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: China Platform Megacaps is scorable (3033.HK) but ranks 15 of 17 (score -1.01), is ineligible, has near-zero breadth (0.0) and the weakest durability (0.14) in the table. The only validated leg is the trend gate, which flags this as a shake-out/avoid candidate — not a return forecast. This is a risk-control avoid, never a short.
evidence: do_not_conclude: do not treat crowding/extension as a sell
theses.dissent: The same 3033.HK proxy covers both China Tech themes, so these two avoids are partly redundant; a broad China-tech relief rally would hit both, and the AI-tech macro dominance could trigger exactly that.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK shows breadth above 0.5 and becomes eligible before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
